verdict.rationale: MotherDuck's automation surface is Flights, scheduled Python jobs for ingest and transformation that agents can build and deploy. The Flights product page says the platform handles "versioning" and logging. That single mention is the only evidence: nothing describes reviewing changes to an automation or rolling back to a prior version. Missing for 10: documented rollback to prior Flight versions, a review/diff or approval workflow for automation changes, in-depth docs on how Flight versioning works, independent or hands-on corroboration.
